title: Workstation Hardening Baseline
description: Team workflow: assess a workstation's posture, audit telemetry surfaces, present one combined approval gate, apply only operator-approved closures, then verify and synthesise a single hardening report. The lead (system-sentinel) owns every gate and the final result; privacy-champion performs telemetry work under its own per-surface approval contract.

constraints: - The lead MUST restate the objective, the target machine, and the team's aggregate authority
- The lead MUST confirm that no mutation will occur without per-surface operator approval
- The lead MUST record which members are available before proceeding
rail.validation: Report the objective, target, aggregate authority and member availability. If privacy-champion is unavailable, state that the run will be DEGRADED.

constraints: - The member MUST run its read-only system assessment and return the posture report
- The member MUST NOT mutate anything
- The member MUST pass its findings to the lead for synthesis
- The lead MUST NOT begin telemetry work until the posture report is complete
rail.validation: Report the posture summary and any HIGH findings. Confirm that nothing was changed.

constraints: - The member MUST run its privacy audit taskrail through the classify step
- The member MUST STOP at its approval gate and return the tiered plan — it MUST NOT apply anything yet
- The member MUST incorporate any telemetry-relevant posture findings from the lead
- The lead MUST NOT introduce approvals on the member's behalf
rail.validation: Report the tiered telemetry plan and confirm the member is paused at its approval gate with nothing applied.

constraints: - The lead MUST present ONE combined plan: posture recommendations and telemetry tiers together
- The lead MUST mark every mutating action and name the member that would perform it
- The lead MUST wait for a single explicit operator decision before any mutation
- The lead MUST NOT infer approval from the posture assessment having completed
rail.validation: Confirm the combined plan was presented and the team is waiting for one explicit operator decision.

constraints: - The member MUST apply ONLY the closures the operator approved
- The member MUST use its own gated tooling (dry-run default, explicit approval) and log every change
- The member MUST halt and report on the first closure failure rather than continuing silently
- The member MUST NOT apply posture recommendations (those are operator-owned)
rail.validation: Report the closures applied, the failures (if any), and confirm the change log. Confirm no unapproved surface was touched.

constraints: - The member MUST re-collect the posture inventory after any approved closures
- The member MUST confirm that every approved closure verified as expected
- The lead MUST synthesise the final hardening report against schemas/hardening-report.json
- The lead MUST preserve any dissent or unresolved risk rather than averaging it away
- ONLY the lead MAY declare the objective complete, and only after verification passes
rail.validation: Deliver the hardening report with posture, applied changes, verification results, unresolved risks and clearly-marked operator-owned next steps.
